svg.title: BLPR architecture
svg.desc: The original BLPR paper figure with moving dashed connectors. Input image, vehicle and plate detection, geometric and photometric preprocessing, character recognition, confidence checking, and the Gemma 3 fallback. Only the arrow shafts move.
